question: What is the name of the full-system integration and ground-testing platform inaugurated to support SARAS Mk-2 aircraft development?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iron Bird facility.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh inaugurated the Iron Bird facility at CSIR–NAL to support testing of the SARAS Mk-2 aircraft.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Iron Bird facility enables full-system integration testing for the SARAS Mk-2 light transport aircraft.**
 
• It is designed to reduce flight-test risks by identifying and resolving system issues on the ground.
 
• The platform helps shorten development timelines by enabling extensive ground-based evaluations.
 
• It supports testing of avionics, hydraulics, flight-control systems and structural interactions for SARAS Mk-2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **SARAS Mk-2**__

 __
 
• 19-seater light transport aircraft for civil and military use.
 
• Designed to support UDAN regional connectivity.
 
• Features include a pressurised cabin, digital avionics and glass cockpit.
 
• Developed to reduce reliance on foreign-made small aircraft.
 
 
 
• **HAP (High Altitude Platform) Facility**__
 __
 
• For building solar-powered unmanned aircraft capable of flying above 20 km.
 
• First full-scale flight planned for 2027.
 
• Supports surveillance, communication and environmental monitoring roles.
 
 
 
• **NAviMet System**__
 
 
• CSIR-NAL’s aviation weather system launched at HAL Airport.
 
• Used for real-time weather observation and reporting.
 
• Part of a broader ecosystem including DRISHTI and AWOS for civil and defence airfields.
